protocol.name: private mixed-compression hybrid diagnostic v1
protocol.qualification: New private protocol; unchanged caller and hybrid libraries. All9labels retained. No timing executed during preparation.
protocol.crc32_control_caveat: CRC is not called inside measured compression, but unchanged warmups call CRC and may affect cache preconditioning in addition to code layout.

notes: New private diagnostic protocol, not unchanged generic PROBE.
Compression loops GCC-calibrated once and fixed across all labels/rounds. Decompression/CRC each1 loop; their timings retained but excluded from summaries.
Unchanged caller performs initial compression and2 warmup iterations including all APIs. Measured compression occurs before the single decompression/CRC loops.
crc32-only keeps measured compression code unchanged but may affect linked layout and cache state from CRC warmup; it is not a strictly unexecuted-code control.
Same immutable library/caller bindings as correctness qualification; hybrids are mixed objects, not new compiler identities.
